press_references.value: Overtime Joins the OH.io Portfolio to Accelerate Demand for Its Voice-First AI Platform for Billing and Collections

partnership_announcements.description: Overtime announced a partnership with OH.io to accelerate demand generation for its voice-first AI billing, collections, and debt-recovery platform. OH.io will provide dedicated go-to-market specialists, inside sales, and account-based marketing support.

partnership_announcements.description: Overtime.ai and Lockhart, Morris & Montgomery formed a strategic partnership to pilot and apply conversational AI across LMM's live collections workflows, aiming to support operational teams, modernize consumer engagement, and drive measurable outcomes.

press_references.value: Overtime pioneering content deal with UConn women’s basketball during March Madness

partnership_announcements.description: Overtime entered a pioneering NIL-based content partnership with UConn Huskies women's basketball, co-developed with CampusOne, to operate a branded content studio on campus during March Madness and produce sponsor-backed content for Wendy's and Google Gemini.

overview_description.description:
Overtime is a sports network for the next generation of sports fans. It produces original content across YouTube, Snapchat, and IGTV, as well as highly engaging short-form content on Instagram and TikTok.

Based in NYC, Overtime is funded by top VC firms like Andreessen Horowitz and Greycroft Ventures as well as industry leaders like Kevin Durant and former NBA Commissioner David Stern.
